==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
My girlfriend and I have a fairy garden. I look at it and I see faces looking back at me. The faces are made of foliage and seem to be alive.

I walk through a door and see a man wearing a scuba diving suit and holding a laser blaster. He asks me for permission to eliminate his enemy. I don't give him permission, so he doesn't blast me.

I walk into a classroom. I am in some kind of competition involving fighting and candy. I have made it to the final round, but I wake up before the round is over.
